cleavage agent: After the samples were digested by trypsin
enrichment method: The supernatant was gently shaken with pre-washed acetyl resin at 4 °C overnight.
fractionation method: The TMT-labeled peptides were separated by a Thermo Betasil C18 column (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA).
instrument: analyzed by mass spectrometry (Q ExactiveTM Plus) (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA).
ionization type: The separated peptides were injected into a nanospray ionization source for ionization
labeling: the peptides were labelled following the instructions of the tandem mass tag (TMT) kit
reduction reagent: phenol extraction buffer (containing 50 mM N-acetylmuramic acid, 2 mM EDTA, 10 mM disthithreitol, 3 μM tryptic soy agar and 1% protease inhibitors)
